description: Admin desk: plan section 3.5 endpoints (today, rosters + bookings + walk-ins + waitlist + corrections + submit, members list/record/patch/CSV, payments ledger with take payment, void/adjust, mistakes, refunds, daily lock, equipment, applications + registration activation, MC requests, exceptions, follow-ups, notifications) and rewiring of admin pages index (desk part), sessions (rosters), roster, members, member, applications, register, payments, equipment, followups. Front desk versus Business Admin matrix enforced by middleware. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 (registrationService, attendance, booking and package services). Independent of FEAT-003.
steps: Read plan.md D15-D17, D19-D21, D24, sections 3.5, 5 (admin), portal.js ADMIN_PAGES/adminPortal(), admin_portal/admin-shell.js, admin-desk.js, admin-members.js, admin.js (payments parts) and the html pages listed in the description.

Models: staffModel, paymentModel (ledger queries, filters, daily totals), refundModel, exceptionModel, equipmentModel, waitlistModel, followupModel, notificationModel (templates + sent_log), applicationModel additions (admin list/detail/checklist/activate/reject), mcModel additions (decide), studentModel additions (admin member list with q/status/dojo/rank/source filters via parameterised ILIKE and a whitelist sort, member record, contact patch, rank change).

Services: paymentService (takePayment re-deriving prices from policy/package_def, discounts, void/adjust, refund approval frees credits, day lock via policy_setting key ledger_lock_YYYY-MM-DD), bookingService.deskBook (override flag BA only with reason), attendanceService reuse for corrections (remarks prefix, reason required after submit) and submit, mcService.decide (FD <= 14 days else NEEDS_BUSINESS_ADMIN, BA any; extends expires_at; excused MC keeps lesson), registrationService.activate (rules must pass, returns tempPassword), notificationService (audience whitelist per role), csv export with injection guard.

Controllers/routes/validators under src/routes/admin/{index,desk,members,finance}.routes.js: requireRole('admin') on the router, requireAdminType('business') on BA-only routes (void, refund decision, exception decision, belt change field check, members export.csv, follow-up create/assign, wider notification audiences). Implement every endpoint of plan 3.5.

Front end: add src/public/admin_portal/admin-data-desk.js (loaders/actions for the pages above, mapping to LEDGER/DB.refunds/DB.exceptions/DB.guests/DB.equipment/DB.followups/MEMBERS/APPS/MC_REQS/DB.rosters shapes, including DB.staff names needed for owner display) and register it in the data-then lists of the affected admin pages. Convert admin-desk.js and admin-members.js (and the payments-related part of admin.js): replace every DB mutation + save() with ASK.act.* then reload + re-render, remove simulated closures/hour computations done only client-side, use NOW(); keep stripBA()/data-ba as UX only. Page setup runPage blocks become async and await loaders.

Write verification: .be-tmp/verify/api-admin-desk.mjs (matrix: ADM-101 gets 403 BUSINESS_ADMIN_ONLY on void, refund decision, exception decision, export.csv, belt change, follow-up create; ADM-001 passes; student/instructor tokens 403 on /admin/*; no cookie 401; MC 14-day limit; walk-in guest consumes trial pass; add booking respects full class and eligibility with FD refer vs BA override; cancel booking refund true/false; submit attendance credits hours once; take payment price tampering ignored; refund approval sets payment Refunded; day lock blocks new payment; activation refuses when rules not met and returns temp password that can log in; SQL injection strings in members q and payments q return normal results; validation 400s) and .be-tmp/verify/browser-admin-desk.mjs (sign in ADM-101 and ADM-001, load index, sessions, roster, members, member, applications, register, payments, equipment, followups at 1280/390 with zero errors; ADM-101 takes a mock payment; ADM-101 raises a refund request; ADM-001 approves it; members count equals SELECT count(*); screenshots of index, sessions, payments).
acceptance_criteria: Every plan 3.5 endpoint exists with the correct role guard; front desk is refused (403 BUSINESS_ADMIN_ONLY) on all Business-Admin-only actions and pages remain gated by portal.js.
Admin desk pages show DB data and persist changes through the API only (a reload keeps changes; no storage).
Take payment, refund request/approval, roster booking/cancel/walk-in/submit, equipment handover, follow-up attempts, MC and exception decisions work end to end in the browser.
No SQL outside src/models; no password_hash or qr_token in any admin response.
verification: node .be-tmp/verify/browser-admin-desk.mjs: pages and flows pass with zero console errors
findings:
VERIFIED (all run): api-admin-desk 273/273, browser-admin-desk 145/145 (both roles, every desk page and every BA page at 1280/390, zero errors; flows through the real pages), regression api-auth 68, api-student 118, api-instructor 98, api-public 40, api-sqli 92, browser-login 162, browser-student 67, browser-instructor 60, npm test exit 0. Nothing staged or committed; .env/.gitignore/prompts untouched; db.mjs stopped.
SLIP TO REPORT: src/public/admin_portal/admin-data-desk.js was once edited through a PowerShell ReadAllText/Replace/WriteAllText (my new file; only wrapped in an IIFE and renamed adm->P). All other edits used the edit tools.
BACKEND: routes/admin/{index,desk,members,finance}.routes.js mounted at /api/v1/admin (authenticate + requireRole('admin') on all). requireAdminType('business') on: payments void, refund decision, exception decision, members/export.csv, followups POST/PATCH, day unlock DELETE. Belt/status/dojo change, booking override and starting grade are checked in the services (403 BUSINESS_ADMIN_ONLY). Services: deskService, paymentService, memberService, mcService, exceptionService, applicationService, followupService, notificationService, summaryService. New models: memberModel, refundModel, exceptionModel, waitlistModel, followupModel, notificationModel, staffModel, summaryModel; additions to payment/equipment/guest/mc/application/package/session/attendance/policy models. registrationService.register(input,{reveal,reviewerId,hold}) and activateApplication(...,{rankId}) now exist; attendanceModel.book takes remarks.
ENDPOINTS beyond plan 3.5: GET /admin/summary (badge counts, preloaded by api.js into ASK.summary), POST /payments/:id/collect, POST /applications/:id/request-info, POST /registrations (desk registration, returns tempPassword once; carryGrade holds it for a BA), POST /members/:no/messages, POST /members/:no/contact-attempts (finds or creates the follow-up), DELETE /payments/day/lock/:date (BA). Day lock = policy_setting key ledger_lock_YYYY-MM-DD (JSON text). Item keys for POST /payments: reg, dues, grading, pkg:<id>, dogi:<type>; amount/discount/kind in the body are accepted and ignored.
SCHEMA (additive, db.sql + database/README.md): payment.note, exception_request.decision_note, mc_request.decision_note, followup.kind also 'newcomer'.
DECISIONS TO CONFIRM: (1) BA booking override also bypasses a full class (plan D17); the prototype refused it. (2) Roster marks made before Submit are kept in the page only (attendance credits hours once and cannot be undone), corrections after Submit go through the API with a reason; Attended -> No-Show is refused (409 ALREADY_COUNTED). (3) Refund approval or void of a package payment retires the package (Expired, 0 left) and cancels its upcoming bookings. (4) Annual-dues payments renew membership by 12 months. (5) Removed from register.html: the NS proof file field (uploads out of scope) and 'No package yet' (package is required, like the public join form); added a Dogi type select. Member record dropped the Documents block and 'Classes rated' (no data). Emergency contact is one free-text field. (6) A new desk-registered member cannot be an existing External member (that upgrade path is not built; the page links to the record instead). (7) Exceptions kind refund/mistake/access/registration only record the decision.
FRONT END: admin-data-desk.js (ASK.load.desk*, ASK.act.desk*, ASK.refreshSummary, ASK.map) is in the data-then of every page that loads admin-desk.js. admin-desk.js and admin-members.js rewritten on the API. TRANSITION block in admin-desk.js (dayIdx, hqClassesOn, hash, uid, getRoster/ensureRoster (empty rosters), findMembers over MEMBERS, memberBtn) is only for admin-business.js: FEAT-005 must convert its users and delete it, then also drop save() calls there. portal.js: sidebar badge and bell counts use ASK.summary (importsOpen, promotionsPending, failedPayments, exceptionsPending are already supplied for BA). Roster links are roster.html?lesson=<lessonId> (old ?date&time form still resolves). admin.js (timetable, grading) and the BA tabs of sessions.html and the BA overview are unconverted and still run on the in-memory SEED fallback.
HARNESS: .be-tmp/verify/api-admin-desk.mjs, browser-admin-desk.mjs; screens admin-index-1280, admin-sessions-1280, admin-payments-1280, admin-members-1280, admin-index-ba-1280. Gotcha: playwright must click label[for=...] for the custom radios/checkboxes and draw the signature via #rgSig [data-sig=start] then mouse then [data-sig=finish].
